description: Implementation of a cache for key system supportability in media codecs, including classes and functions for managing supportability data for audio and video codecs.

classes.name: KeySystemSupportabilityContainer
classes.description: Template class managing supportability data for key systems associated with a specific codec type.

methods.name: GetKeySystemSupportability
methods.description: Retrieves supportability status for a given codec and key system.

methods.name: CacheKeySystemSupportability
methods.description: Caches supportability status for a given codec and key system.
